question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Kinship
solution: The correct answer is '**Relationship**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Kinship**' is '**Relationship**'. • **Kinship**: the relationship between the members of the same family. (सगोत्रता) • *Example: the ties of **kinship**...* • **Relationship**: the way that people, groups, countries, etc. feel about or behave towards each other. [(किसी के साथ या किन्‍हीं दो व्‍यक्ति, संगठनों या देशों के बीच) संबंध] • *Example: The **relationship** between the parents and the school has improved greatly.* **Correct Answer:__** *Relationship.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Viewership**: the number or type of people who watch a particular television programme, channel or film. (प्रोग्राम, चैनल या फ़िल्म विशेष को देखनेवाले लोगों की संख्या या श्रेणी; दर्शकगण, प्रेक्षकगण) • **Partnership**: the state of being a partner in business. (व्‍यापार में भागीदारी या साझेदारी) • **Incompatibility**: the condition of two things being so different in nature as to be incapable of coexisting. (असंगति, बेमेलपन) 3e:T54b, The correct answer is** 'In a similar situation'.**
